## Problem and change

Describe the trigger, resulting behavior and why the change belongs in this project.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Separate source tests, package audits,
browser/emulator inspection and physical-device testing. Include a versioned
capture for visual changes.

## Remaining gaps

State any unverified behavior, compatibility impact or follow-up work. Preserve
existing frozen releases, licences and dependency pins unless the PR explicitly
changes that scope.
